audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defects field flags it directly: this matchup never names a real Hwei ability. 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' (used 9+ times across full/content), 'QQ Fireflies', 'Gathering Fire haste', 'EE disengage', 'QE trap', 'EQ vulnerability combo' are all fabricated — none exist in Hwei's kit.
audit.why: Hwei's real kit is P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment (the CC-carrying paint — matches the existing correct claim 'All his CC lives on E'), R Spiraling Despair. A player using these fake names to track cooldowns or read the loading screen gets nothing usable.
audit.corrected: Replaced every fabricated name with the real ability + slot across full and content layers.
sources: brief enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text and names

audit.why: The level 1-2 Hwei lead into level-3 Karma swing into level-6 Hwei re-lead into 2-item Karma close matches the kits: Hwei out-ranges pre-3 with one spell up, Karma's E/W online at 3 flips it, Hwei's three-spell R window re-leads, Karma's Mantra utility closes it out.
Tricky/7-10 difficulty rating is consistent with a poke-mirror where Hwei's stacked spell rotation out-tempos a single Mantra recast pre-6.
